title: FidelyCheck
tagline: FideliCheck is an incentive program to earn fan tokens and POAPs as they attend physical events.
description: FideliCheck is a year-long competitive loyalty program where fans pay a €100 entry fee and earn XP by attending real-life events. The more they participate, the higher they climb in the ranking. At the end of the season, 80% of all collected funds are redistributed as cash prizes to the top 100 fans.
how_its_made: FideliCheck is built using a modular architecture combining a React front-end, a Node.js backend and smart contracts deployed on the Chiliz Chain. We implement the POAP minting and reward distribution system. The system is thought to be fast, secure and transparent, and required a few creative hacks
